login.head: Sign in
login.title: Sign in
login.expired_subtitle: Sign-in links only work for a short while.
login.expired_body: Go back to the application and choose “Sign in” again.
login.sso_subtitle: Enter your work email and we’ll send you to your organisation’s sign-in.
login.code_resent: Another code is on its way.
login.closed_body: Nobody can sign in at the moment. Try again later, or ask whoever runs this service.
login.remember_hint: Leave this off on a shared computer.
login.passkey_cancelled: No passkey was used. Try again, or sign in another way.

register.head: Create an account
register.title: Create your account
register.start_subtitle: Accounts are created while signing in to an application.
register.closed_body: {app} does not allow creating accounts here. Ask whoever runs it for access.

forgot.head: Reset your password
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent_body: If an account exists for {email}, we’ve sent a link to reset its password. It works for one hour.
forgot.sent_hint: Didn’t get it? Check your spam folder, or try again in a few minutes.

reset.head: Choose a new password
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.temporary: Your password was set by an administrator. Choose your own to continue.
reset.done_body: Your password has been changed, and you’ve been signed out everywhere else.
reset.expired_body: Reset links work once, for one hour. Ask for a new one and use the latest email.

verify.head: Confirm your email
verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.subtitle: One click, and you can sign in.
verify.done_body: Thank you. You can sign in now.

logout.head: Sign out
logout.title: Sign out?
logout.body: You’ll be signed out on this device.
logout.stay: Stay signed in and return to {app}

logged_out.head: Signed out
logged_out.title: You’re signed out
logged_out.body: You have been signed out on this device.

agreements.head: Terms
agreements.title: Before you continue
agreements.body: Read and accept the terms of {org} to continue.
agreements.expired_body: Go back to the application and sign in again.

consent.head: Allow access
consent.title: {app} wants to access your account
consent.later: You can disconnect it at any time from your account.
consent.expired_body: Go back to the application and sign in again.

scope.offline_access: Stay connected while you are not using it

second_factor.head: Two-step verification
second_factor.title: Confirm it’s you
second_factor.step_up_app: {app} asks for two-step verification. Use your second factor to continue.
second_factor.enrol_app: {app} asks for two-step verification. Set it up now to continue.
second_factor.enrol_subtitle: This sign-in asks for two-step verification. Set it up now to continue.
second_factor.enrol_choose: Choose what you’ll confirm it’s you with, each time you sign in after your password.
second_factor.enrol_done: Two-step verification is on. Save your recovery codes, then continue.
second_factor.passkey_failed: Your passkey didn’t answer. Try again, or use a code.
second_factor.code_hint: Open the app and type the six digits it shows.
second_factor.recovery_hint: One of the codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each works once.

frontchannel.head: Signing out
frontchannel.body: Signing you out of your applications…

device.head: Sign in a device
device.title: Sign in on your device
device.subtitle: Signed in as {email}
device.enter: Enter the code your device shows.
device.asks: {app} on your device will be able to:
device.allowed_body: You can go back to your device now, and close this page.
device.denied_title: Your device was not signed in
